description: A fractal art generator. Manipulate mesmerizing, fiery visuals in real-time by adjusting speed, detail, color, and more. A creative coding experiment.

description: Create, play, and share retro drum beats with Retro Beatbox, an online 16-step sequencer inspired by classic beat machines. Perfect for musicians and hobbyists.

name: ChrisPirillo/orbit-trails
description: Orbit Trails is an interactive WebGL shader toy that generates mesmerizing, abstract fractal patterns in real-time. Adjust parameters like swirl, detail, and brightness to create your own unique visual art.

name: ChrisPirillo/fractal-flower
description: Explore Fractal Flower, an interactive real-time WebGL application that generates mesmerizing, flower-like fractal patterns. Customize the visuals with intuitive controls.

name: ChrisPirillo/cube-garden
description: Create, customize, and explore a mesmerizing 3D garden of cubes. An interactive art generator where you control the geometry, colors, and motion.

name: ChrisPirillo/charactercade
description: An interactive generative art application that creates mesmerizing, cascading ASCII art. Customize the visuals in real-time and export your unique creation as a 4K wallpaper.

name: ChrisPirillo/bingo-maker
description: Use the Bingo Maker to create and play your own custom bingo cards! Enter 24 words, generate a unique bingo board, and download the game to play anytime. Perfect for parties, meetings, and events.

name: ChrisPirillo/alumisphere
description: An interactive WebGL art experience. Manipulate a dynamic, shimmering sphere with real-time controls for zoom, animation speed, noise, and color.

name: ChrisPirillo/apple-glow
description: Experience 'Apple Glow,' a mesmerizing interactive WebGL shader. Manipulate vibrant, glowing patterns and explore the beauty of generative art in your browser.

name: ChrisPirillo/lcars
description: An interactive, generative LCARS (Library Computer Access/Retrieval System) interface inspired by Star Trek. This dynamic web application creates randomized futuristic layouts and data streams.

name: ChrisPirillo/brickout
description: Play Brickout, a modern tribute to the classic arcade brick-breaking games. Enjoy retro graphics, power-ups, and challenging levels.

name: ChrisPirillo/social-me
description: Social Me: A central hub for all of Chris Pirillo's social media profiles, projects, events, and contact information. Connect with Chris across the web.

name: ChrisPirillo/shape-weaver
description: Explore Shape Weaver, an interactive 3D particle physics simulation. Morph particles into various shapes, customize colors, and apply real-time effects in this stunning WebGL experience.

name: ChrisPirillo/neotropolis
description: Explore Neotropolis, a real-time, interactive WebGL shader art experience. Customize psychedelic, abstract cityscapes and visual effects directly in your browser.

name: ChrisPirillo/scroll-city
description: Experience Scroll City, an interactive, procedurally generated cyberpunk cityscape. Control the scroll speed, direction, city density, and visual effects to create your own futuristic metropolis.

name: ChrisPirillo/qlock
description: Qlock is a visually stunning, minimalist web application that tells time using words instead of numbers, displayed in a clean, elegant grid.

name: ChrisPirillo/blinking-1200
description: Remember the old VCRs and digital clocks perpetually flashing 12:00? Relive that retro nostalgia with this simple, full-screen blinking clock animation.

name: ChrisPirillo/simon-says
description: Test your memory with Simon Says, a classic arcade game reimagined. Follow the sequence of lights and sounds. How long can you last? Features spinning, color-shifting, and randomizing modes for an extra challenge.

name: ChrisPirillo/electronic-sorcerer
description: Play Electronic Sorcerer, a collection of classic retro handheld electronic games like Tic-Tac-Toe, Echo, and Blackjack 13. A nostalgic digital toy for all ages.
